description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application, including models, command handling, validation, and database interactions for editing user details.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Main class encapsulating the user editing feature, including nested classes.

classes.name: UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user profile fields that can be edited.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the user data to be updated.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator ensuring the command's user data is not null.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Handles the processing of the user edit command, including database access and business logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the edit command, updates the user in the database, manages password hashing, and returns the updated user envelope.
